candidates.title: MeshKV: A Network-on-Chip KV Cache Fabric for Scalable Transformer Decoding Accelerators
candidates.reason: Hardware/system co-design for KV-cache movement on tiled accelerators using packetized NoC flows, striping, multicast and overlapped prefetch; reports up to 1.9x multi-stream throughput.

candidates.title: Efficient LLM Coserving at the Edge via Resource-Aware Cooperative Scheduling
candidates.reason: Offloading-based edge LLM coserving system that schedules around PCIe bandwidth and CPU/GPU utilization; reports up to 27.4% higher offline throughput without harming high-priority latency.

candidates.title: SplitScaling: Adaptive Scaling for Disaggregated LLM Serving Against Traffic Bursts via DRL
candidates.reason: Disaggregated prefill/decode autoscaling with DRL and immediate rescheduling under bursty traces; reports 25.2–28.3% lower compute cost while meeting SLOs.

candidates.title: Load balancing for large language model inference serving: A control and learning oriented survey
candidates.reason: Recent dedicated survey of LLM inference-serving load balancing from control and learning perspectives; useful survey coverage for scheduling/serving taxonomy.
